snippet.title: Torizon Telecom Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4599560/Torizon_Telecom/


"Telecom"—a strict, infinite world composed solely of letters and words.
...And the subjects controlled by Telecom.

That is, you. Today, you are participating in various operations and battles under the control of the Telecom system. Your emotions, thoughts, and ego are still governed by Telecom.

Until an anomaly of unknown origin occurred...

A world where everything is text. Telecom.
...But does another world exist outside of Telecom? Or is Telecom the only thing in existence?

And who... are you really?
